changelog:
Initial release of the cruit-recruiter skill.

- Lets users search Cruit for AI-native developers and reach out to them.
- Guides recruiters through a 7-step setup flow (authenticate, check access, add company context, describe role, review filters and candidates, reveal/message candidates).
- Provides low-PII candidate previews, only revealing contact info or sending messages with explicit user confirmation.
- Integration emphasizes user safety: never spends contact credits or reveals info without user approval.
- Automatically fetches the latest instructions from the canonical URL each run, defaulting to snapshot if unavailable.
summary: Search Cruit for AI-native developers and reach out to them. Use when the user wants to recruit, source, find developers with specific skills or recency, ins...
